source.establishes: Reference standard and protective cap exist; internal cap fit dimensions are not supplied

current_geometry_issue: Current inferred cap bore radius 26.3 mm exceeds the 26 mm holder-body radius and has no internal stop, so a face-down reference could bottom on its optical face.

candidate_cap_inference.support: Cap rim supports the non-optical body shoulder; smaller nose enters the opening. This is an unverified mechanical reconstruction, not a manufacturer tolerance or a robot fixture.

candidate_sequence: Reference starts protected in its cap.
Retrieve by the non-optical holder, carry through four lateral foot placements and seat on the sphere port.
Close the access before background; actual scan-control interactions are unfinished.
Reopen and reverse the transfer, seating the non-optical shoulder on the cap rim before release.
Proceed to specimen exchange; its ordinary-tool handling is unfinished.
remaining: Ordinary-tweezer specimen handling, background/sample control, matched specimen identity and station transfers
Support forces, stability, contamination control and sensor-driven physics qualification
